title: Profil de course — 42km du Mont-Blanc (édition 2025)
claims: The one-page profile PDF is linked from the official French 42 km page as 'Profil de course'.

The profile plots altitude in metres against distance in kilometres and names the main points, including Le Tour at 1,465 m, Aiguillette des Posettes at 2,200 m, Col des Posettes at 1,999 m, Vallorcine at 1,276 m, Le Béchar at 1,700 m, La Flégère at 1,894 m and Le Châtelard at 1,810 m.
The sheet marks time barriers, full refreshment stations and the hot dog plus beer point, is a 2025-05 static PDF rather than a GPX file, and carries no stated reuse licence.
